answer: Coordination deposit per action charges each agent identity a refundable deposit for every distinct peer it contacts in a rolling 24-hour window; a grove of new identities pays the same floor. Enforcement returns deposits only after peers confirm independent execution, so fake links and recycled yarrow tags leave forfeitable balances. An attacker pays that floor per identity plus forfeited deposits per unconfirmed link, and saffron-certified clusters cannot waive it.
